edits.original: Operators procured spinning reserve, rather than non-spinning reserve.
edits.replacement: Operators procured spinning reserve—capacity already synchronized to the grid and able to respond within minutes.
edits.reason: Spinning versus non-spinning reserve is a real, checkable distinction rather than an ordinary-knowledge antonym, so it is stated positively in its own clause instead of tacked on as a 'rather than' trailer.

edits.replacement: Those upgrades are planned on purpose.
edits.reason: On purpose/by accident is an ordinary-knowledge antonym pair, so the vacuous trailer is cut.

edits.original: Renewable units are often sited where resources are abundant, not where demand peaks, requiring robust transmission networks.
edits.replacement: Renewable units are often sited where resources are abundant. Such locations frequently lie far from demand peaks, requiring robust transmission networks.
